review_scope: Reviewed proposal JSONs and HANDOFF.md compared with original task contracts, finite synthetic evaluator, binding plan and exact text-only export implementation

paper.title: Wetting transitions in droplet drying on soft materials

test_results.export_freeze_requirement: Freeze the final package after review/status updates and verify the resulting release archive; independent mutations use temporary copies only

resolved_findings.finding: The original R11 synthetic fixture assigned CY campaign context to the dedicated PDMS30:1 detection-limit operation; incompatible material requests could also obtain ancestry for PDMS-only routes.
resolved_findings.resolution: Mixed campaigns now use explicit MULTI context and per-operation constituent material lineages with distinct sample/spot/droplet IDs. R11_O06 is PDMS30:1 only; R11_O05 is CY5:6/CY9:10. Incompatible route-family inputs are rejected.

resolved_findings.finding: Finite scan endpoints could overflow the derived scan duration to infinity.
resolved_findings.resolution: The timing contract rejects nonfinite derived duration and negative scan start.

resolved_findings.finding: A package accessed through a symlinked parent could bypass the original root/member symlink checks.
resolved_findings.resolution: The exporter checks lexical absolute root/destination paths and every ancestor for symlinks before freezing, verifying or building an archive.

resolved_findings.finding: The rigid-PDMS receding-angle operation inherited the compliant PDMS50:1 material scope.
resolved_findings.resolution: R09_O06 is scoped to rigid PDMS9:1. Current-ridge/traction/equilibrium operations R14_O03 through R14_O05 are scoped to the CY materials, while the overall mechanism campaign retains distinct control and phase-study links.

verified_invariants: All 16 route IDs and 74 operation IDs/descriptions preserve the reviewed proposal; all task operations explicitly remain authored contracts rather than a source robot protocol.
All 10 source cautions and 25 missing-input records preserve their reviewed source fields, with additional exact operation and scope mappings.
Source-reference values, newly authored task behavior and unresolved qualification inputs remain separately labelled.
R07 is an external qualified contained patterned-substrate receipt boundary. No quantum-dot synthesis, ink-handling or high-voltage deposition recipe/control is implemented.
Conflict and qualification holds are local to affected operation/claim scopes; original-source-data absence does not itself block newly designed independent observations.
Every failed route reaches an independently accounted closeout path; missing isolation produces held-contained status and never physical removal.
Evaluator-pinned registries reject mutation, rehash laundering, actor-added outcomes, changed context, duplicate/missing events, reordering and cross-fixture replay.
Droplet, spot, specimen, timepoint and cohort counts remain distinct; source cohort overlap and statistical independence are not asserted.
The 55 nL origin is macro-only and brackets an actual synthetic downward threshold crossing; it is not imposed on the 49 nL microscopy example.

Measured, manually annotated, imputed and inferred-reference coordinate kinds remain distinct; one-to-one correspondence requires declared stationary-boundary evidence and never claims solver execution.
Current-placement P1 tangents remain separate from Ur/Uz displacement fits, and a source-only receding-angle reference cannot satisfy a new-measurement gate.
Synthetic traction-area algebra preserves declared physical-area measure, explicit conflict dispositions and force units without validating inverse FE, equilibrium or a dynamic force balance.
Dated synthetic age custody and humidity stability/accuracy semantics do not establish actual storage or instrument qualification.
Every operation has original asset/anchor bindings and noncontrol/scale guards; patterned and closeout routes retain containment guards.

Export rejects nonallowlisted files, directories, traversal/aliases, duplicate ZIP members, invalid manifest fields, changed hashes, special-file modes, symlinked ancestors, private-path sentinels, binary/NUL content and internal archive destinations.
Only agent_visible.json is actor-visible; the full export remains evaluator/auditor material. Source outcomes are not actor observations.
retained_limits: This is an independent review of the reviewed source proposal and current implementation, not a fresh acquisition or reanalysis of the original paper/media/workbook.
Source workbook numerical cells remain unread; the recorded movie inspection remains six sampled frames, not continuous playback or timing analysis.
The finite evaluator is public synthetic fixture matching and bounded arithmetic, not a general campaign verifier, production authentication system or scientific solver.
No robot, hardware service, gas/optical control, image analysis, graph-relaxation solver or inverse FE solver was executed.
No real sample, storage interval, containment, calibration, grasp, collision geometry, uncertainty model or scientific outcome was qualified.
Integrity hashes and a text-only allowlist are not cryptographic publisher signatures or an automatic rights/provenance classifier; reviewed contents and trust boundaries remain required.
All 25 qualification inputs and the applicable unresolved source cautions remain holds for real implementation.
